G5400.def: neuter of a derivative of «5399»; a frightening thing, i.e. terrific portent:--fearful sight.

G5401.et: from a primary phebomai (to be put in fear)
G5401.def: from a primary phebomai (to be put in fear); alarm or fright:--be afraid, + exceedingly, fear, terror.

G5402.et: from phoibos (bright, probably akin to the base of (5457))
G5402.def: feminine of phoibos (bright; probably akin to the base of «5457»); Phoebe, a Christian woman:--Phebe.

G5403.def: from «5404»; palm-country; Phoenice (or Phoenicia), a region of Palestine:--Phenice, Phenicia.

G5405.def: probably the same as «5404»; Phoenix, a place in Crete:--Phenice.

G5406.def: from «5408»; a murderer (always of criminal (or at least intentional) homicide; which «443» does not necessarily imply; while «4607» is a special term for a public bandit):--murderer.

G5407.def: from «5406»; to be a murderer (of):--kill, do murder, slay.

G5408.et: from an obsolete primary pheno (to murder)
G5408.def: from an obsolete primary pheno (to slay); murder:--murder, + be slain with, slaughter.

G5409.def: from «5411»; to have a burden, i.e. (by analogy) to wear as clothing or a constant accompaniment:--bear, wear.

G5410.def: of Latin origin; a forum or market-place; only in comparative with «675»; a station on the Appian road:--forum.

G5411.def: from «5342»; a load (as borne), i.e. (figuratively) a tax (properly, an individual assessment on persons or property; whereas «5056» is usually a general toll on goods or travel):--tribute.

G5412.def: from «5414»; to load up (properly, as a vessel or animal), i.e. (figuratively) to overburden with ceremony (or spiritual anxiety):--lade, by heavy laden.

G5413.def: diminutive of «5414»; an invoice (as part of freight), i.e. (figuratively) a task or service:--burden.

G5414.def: from «5342»; something carried, i.e. the cargo of a ship:--lading.

G5415.def: of Latin origin; "fortunate"; Fortunatus, a Christian:--Fortunatus.

G5416.et: from a derivative from the base of (5417)
G5416.def: neuter of a derivative from the base of «5417»; a whip, i.e. Roman lash as a public punishment:--scourge.

G5417.et: from a presumed equivalent of the Latin flagellum
G5417.def: from a presumed equivalent of the Latin flagellum; to whip, i.e. lash as a public punishment:--scourge.

G5418.def: from «5420»; a fence, or inclosing barrier (literally or figuratively):--hedge (+ round about), partition.

G5419.et: probably akin to (5420) through the idea of defining
G5419.def: probably akin to «5420» through the idea of defining; to indicate (by word or act), i.e. (specially), to expound:-- declare.

G5420.et: apparently a strengthening form of the base of (5424)
G5420.def: apparently a strengthening form of the base of «5424»; to fence or inclose, i.e. (specially), to block up (figuratively, to silence):--stop.

G5421.def: of uncertain derivation; a hole in the ground (dug for obtaining or holding water or other purposes), i.e. a cistern or well; figuratively, an abyss (as a prison):--well, pit.

G5422.def: from «5423»; to be a mind-misleader, i.e. delude:--deceive.

G5423.def: from «5424» and «539»; a mind-misleader, i.e. seducer:--deceiver.

G5424.et: probably from an obsolete phrao (to rein in or curb, cf (5420))
G5424.def: probably from an obsolete phrao (to rein in or curb; compare «5420»); the midrif (as a partition of the body), i.e. (figuratively and by implication, of sympathy) the feelings (or sensitive nature; by extension (also in the plural) the mind or cognitive faculties):--understanding.

G5425.def: apparently a primary verb; to "bristle" or chill, i.e. shudder (fear):--tremble.

G5426.def: from «5424»; to exercise the mind, i.e. entertain or have a sentiment or opinion; by implication, to be (mentally) disposed (more or less earnestly in a certain direction); intensively, to interest oneself in (with concern or obedience):--set the affection on, (be) care(-ful), (be like-, + be of one, + be of the same, + let this) mind(-ed), regard, savour, think.

G5427.def: from «5426»; (mental) inclination or purpose:--(be, + be carnally, + be spiritually) mind(-ed).

G5428.def: from «5426»; mental action or activity, i.e. intellectual or moral insight:--prudence, wisdom.

G5429.def: from «5424»; thoughtful, i.e. sagacious or discreet (implying a cautious character; while «4680» denotes practical skill or acumen; and «4908» indicates rather intelligence or mental acquirement); in a bad sense conceited (also in the comparative):--wise(-r).

G5431.def: from a derivative of «5424»; to exercise thought, i.e. be anxious:--be careful.

G5432.def: from a compound of «4253» and «3708»; to be a watcher in advance, i.e. to mount guard as a sentinel (post spies at gates); figuratively, to hem in, protect:--keep (with a garrison). Compare «5083».

G5433.def: akin to «1032», «1031»; to snort (as a spirited horse), i.e. (figuratively) to make a tumult:--rage.

G5434.et: from a presumed derivative of phrugo (to roast or parch, akin to the base of (5395))
G5434.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of phrugo (to roast or parch; akin to the base of «5395»); something desiccated, i.e. a dry twig:--stick.

G5435.def: probably of foreign origin; Phrygia, a region of Asia Minor:--Phrygia.

G5436.def: probably from «5343»; fugitive; Phygellus, an apostate Christian:--Phygellus.

G5438.def: from «5442»; a guarding or (concretely, guard), the act, the person; figuratively, the place, the condition, or (specially), the time (as a division of day or night), literally or figuratively:--cage, hold, (im-)prison(-ment), ward, watch.

G5440.def: neuter of a derivative of «5442»; a guard-case, i.e. "phylactery" for wearing slips of Scripture texts:-- phylactery.

G5442.et: probably from (5443) through the idea of isolation
G5442.def: probably from «5443» through the idea of isolation; to watch, i.e. be on guard (literally of figuratively); by implication, to preserve, obey, avoid:--beward, keep (self), observe, save. Compare «5083».

G5443.def: from «5453» (compare «5444»); an offshoot, i.e. race or clan:--kindred, tribe.

G5444.def: from the same as «5443»; a sprout, i.e. leaf:--leaf.

G5445.et: from a prolonged form of phuro (to mix a liquid with a solid, perhaps akin to (5453) through the idea of swelling in bulk), mean to knead
G5445.def: from a prolonged form of phuro (to mix a liquid with a solid; perhaps akin to «5453» through the idea of swelling in bulk), mean to knead; a mass of dough:--lump.

G5448.et: from (5449) in the primary sense of blowing
G5448.def: from «5449» in the primary sense of blowing; to inflate, i.e. (figuratively) make proud (haughty):--puff up.

G5449.def: from «5453»; growth (by germination or expansion), i.e. (by implication) natural production (lineal descent); by extension, a genus or sort; figuratively, native disposition, constitution or usage:--(man-)kind, nature(-al).

G5451.def: from «5452»; trans-planting, i.e. (concretely) a shrub or vegetable:--plant.

G5452.def: from a derivative of «5453»; to set out in the earth, i.e. implant; figuratively, to instil doctrine:--plant.

G5453.et: a primary verb, probably originally, to "puff" or blow, i.e. to swell up
G5453.def: a primary verb; probably originally, to "puff" or blow, i.e. to swell up; but only used in the implied sense, to germinate or grow (sprout, produce), literally or figuratively:--spring (up).

G5454.def: of uncertain derivative; a burrow or lurking-place:--hole.

G5455.def: from «5456»; to emit a sound (animal, human or instrumental); by implication, to address in words or by name, also in imitation:--call (for), crow, cry.

G5456.et: probably akin to (5316) through the idea of disclosure
G5456.def: probably akin to «5316» through the idea of disclosure; a tone (articulate, bestial or artificial); by implication, an address (for any purpose), saying or language:--noise, sound, voice.

G5457.et: from an obsolete phao (to shine or make manifest, especially by rays, cf (5316), (5346))
G5457.def: from an obsolete phao (to shine or make manifest, especially by rays; compare «5316», «5346»); luminousness (in the widest application, natural or artificial, abstract or concrete, literal or figurative):--fire, light.

G5458.def: from «5457»; an illuminator, i.e. (concretely) a luminary, or (abstractly) brilliancy:--light.

G5459.def: from «5457» and «5342»; light-bearing ("phosphorus"), i.e. (specially), the morning-star (figuratively):--day star.

G5460.def: from «5457»; lustrous, i.e. transparent or well-illuminated (figuratively):--bright, full of light.

G5461.def: from «5457»; to shed rays, i.e. to shine or (transitively) to brighten up (literally or figuratively):--enlighten, illuminate, (bring to, give) light, make to see.

G5463.def: a primary verb; to be "cheer"ful, i.e. calmly happy or well-off; impersonally, especially as salutation (on meeting or parting), be well:--farewell, be glad, God speed, greeting, hall, joy(- fully), rejoice.

G5465.def: from the base of «5490»; to lower (as into a void):--let down, strike.

G5466.def: probably of Hebrew or («03778»); a Chaldoean (i.e. Kasdi), or native or the region of the lower Euphrates:--Chaldaean.

G5467.et: perhaps from (5465) through the idea of reducing the strength
G5467.def: perhaps from «5465» through the idea of reducing the strength; difficult, i.e. dangerous, or (by implication) furious:--fierce, perilous.

G5468.et: from a compound of (5469) and the reduplicated form of (71)
G5468.def: from a compound of «5469» and the reduplicated form of «71»; to be a bit-leader, i.e. to curb (figuratively):--bridle.

G5469.def: from «5465»; a curb or head-stall (as curbing the spirit):--bit, bridle.

G5473.def: diminutive from «5475»; a copper dish:--brazen vessel.

G5474.et: from a compound of (5475) and (3030) (in the implied mean of whiteness or brilliancy)
G5474.def: neuter of a compound of «5475» and «3030» (in the implied mean of whiteness or brilliancy); burnished copper, an alloy of copper (or gold) and silver having a brilliant lustre:--fine brass.

G5475.et: perhaps from (5465) through the idea of hollowing out as a vessel (this metal being chiefly used for that purpose)
G5475.def: perhaps from «5465» through the idea of hollowing out as a vessel (this metal being chiefly used for that purpose); copper (the substance, or some implement or coin made of it):--brass, money.

G5476.et: perhaps from the base of (5490) through the idea of a fissure in the soil
G5476.def: adverb perhaps from the base of «5490» through the idea of a fissure in the soil; earthward, i.e. prostrate:--on (to) the ground.

G5477.def: of Hebrew origin («03667»); Chanaan (i.e. Kenaan), the early name of Palestine:--Chanaan.

G5478.def: from «5477»; a Chanaanoean (i.e. Kenaanite), or native of gentile Palestine:--of Canaan.

G5479.def: from «5463»; cheerfulness, i.e. calm delight:--gladness, × greatly, (X be exceeding) joy(-ful, -fully, -fulness, -ous).

G5480.def: from the same as «5482»; a scratch or etching, i.e. stamp (as a badge of servitude), or scupltured figure (statue):--graven, mark.

G5481.def: from the same as «5482»; a graver (the tool or the person), i.e. (by implication) engraving (("character"), the figure stamped, i.e. an exact copy or (figuratively) representation):--express image.

G5482.et: from charasso (to sharpen to a point, akin to (1125) through the idea of scratching)
G5482.def: from charasso (to sharpen to a point; akin to «1125» through the idea of scratching); a stake, i.e. (by implication) a palisade or rampart (military mound for circumvallation in a siege):--trench.

G5483.def: middle voice from «5485»; to grant as a favor, i.e. gratuitously, in kindness, pardon or rescue:--deliver, (frankly) forgive, (freely) give, grant.

G5484.def: accusative case of «5485» as preposition; through favor of, i.e. on account of:--be-(for) cause of, for sake of, +...fore, × reproachfully.

G5485.def: from «5463»; graciousness (as gratifying), of manner or act (abstract or concrete; literal, figurative or spiritual; especially the divine influence upon the heart, and its reflection in the life; including gratitude):--acceptable, benefit, favour, gift, grace(- ious), joy, liberality, pleasure, thank(-s, -worthy).

G5486.def: from «5483»; a (divine) gratuity, i.e. deliverance (from danger or passion); (specially), a (spiritual) endowment, i.e. (subjectively) religious qualification, or (objectively) miraculous faculty:--(free) gift.

G5487.def: from «5485»; to grace, i.e. indue with special honor:--make accepted, be highly favoured.

G5488.def: of Hebrew origin («02771»); Charrhan (i.e. Charan), a place in Mesopotamia:--Charran.

G5489.def: from the same as «5482»; a sheet ("chart") of writing-material (as to be scribbled over):--paper.

G5490.et: from a form of an obsolete prim chao (to "gape" or "yawn")
G5490.def: from a form of an obsolete primary chao (to "gape" or "yawn"); a "chasm" or vacancy (impassable interval):--gulf.

G5491.et: from a form of the same as (5490)
G5491.def: from a form of the same as «5490»; a lip (as a pouring place); figuratively, a margin (of water):--lip, shore.

G5492.def: from the same as «5494»; to storm, i.e. (passively) to labor under a gale:--be tossed with tempest.

G5493.def: from the base of «5494» and «4482»; a storm-runlet, i.e. winter-torrent:--brook.

G5494.et: from a derivative of cheo (to pour, akin to the base of (5490) through the idea of a channel), meaning a storm (as pouring rain)
G5494.def: from a derivative of cheo (to pour; akin to the base of 5490 through the idea of a channel), meaning a storm (as pouring rain); by implication, the rainy season, i.e. winter:--tempest, foul weather, winter.

G5495.et: perhaps from the base of (5494) in the sense of its congener the base of (5490) (through the idea of hollowness for grasping)
G5495.def: perhaps from the base of «5494» in the sense of its congener the base of «5490» (through the idea of hollowness for grasping); the hand (literally or figuratively (power); especially (by Hebraism) a means or instrument):--hand.

G5496.def: from «5497»; to be a hand-leader, i.e. to guide (a blind person):--lead by the hand.

G5497.et: from (5495) and a reduplicated form of (71)
G5497.def: from «5495» and a reduplicated form of «71»; a hand-leader, i.e. personal conductor (of a blind person):--some to lead by the hand.

G5498.def: neuter of a compound of «5495» and «1125»; something hand-written ("chirograph"), i.e. a manuscript (specially, a legal document or bond (figuratively)):--handwriting.

G5499.def: from «5495» and a derivative of «4160»; manufactured, i.e. of human construction:--made by (make with) hands.
